messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: what is lineheight in theme_text()?
parts:
It's the height of a line - i.e. how much vertical space is there
between the baseline of text in subsequent lines. It will only matter
if you're displaying text made up of multiple lines - i.e. "a\nb"

Hadley
